meta.name: frontend-dev-guidelines
meta.description: Frontend development guidelines for React/TypeScript applications. Modern patterns including Suspense, lazy loading, useSuspenseQuery, file organization with features directory, MUI v7 styling, TanStack Router, performance optimization, and TypeScript best practices. Use when creating components, pages, features, fetching data, styling, routing, or working with frontend code.

copy.tagline: 按最佳实践构建前端组件与页面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 React/TypeScript 开发前端应用
copy.tagline_en: Build frontend components and pages with best practices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you develop frontend apps with React/TypeScript

howto.what: Claude 会按照 React/TypeScript 最佳实践生成前端代码，包括使用 Suspense 加载、懒加载组件、useSuspenseQuery 获取数据、按 features 目录组织文件、MUI v7 样式、TanStack Router 路由，并避免早期返回加载状态。
howto.when: 当你要求创建组件、页面、功能模块、获取数据、设置路由、编写样式或优化性能时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个用户列表组件，使用 Suspense 加载数据。
用 TanStack Router 设置一个懒加载的路由页面。

howto.what_en: Claude will generate frontend code following React/TypeScript best practices, including Suspense-based loading, lazy loading, useSuspenseQuery for data fetching, features directory organization, MUI v7 styling, TanStack Router, and avoiding early returns with loading spinners.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create components, pages, features, fetch data, set up routing, style components, or optimize performance.

say_en.text: Create a user list component with Suspense data loading.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a component with useSuspenseQuery and SuspenseLoader.

say_en.text: Set up a features directory for blog with api, components subdirectories.
say_en.note: Claude will create features/blog/ with standard subdirectories.

say_en.text: Set up a lazy-loaded route using TanStack Router.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a route file with React.lazy.
